items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Played Marmaloo's with a nice band Marmaloo's, too. ... He was on trumpet though, when she was Wheatle.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. He's a good bass player.

He did. Yeah. Played his mama a little bit. Nice man mama a little bit too. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Played their salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa salsa I said, gee, what do you think I'm the greatest in the world? Right now, you think I'm the best. You know, I played them fellas then. Wheatle's always like brothers. He's a good bass player, isn't he? He is. Played Marmaloo's with a nice band Marmaloo's, too. Played nice to Justin and I think. Who played trumpet at…
You know something we haven't hit is those brass bands that you played with. How many brass bands have you played with through the years? I played with most of the brass bands.
